metadata.question: Did Arrachart in Madagascar recieve more than 22 inches of rainfall during the month of January 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Arrachart, Madagascar (need to define coordinates) - Time period: January 2020 (2020-01-01 to 2020-01-31) - Data source: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Stations) - best for rainfall analysis - Alternative: ERA5 precipitation if CHIRPS unavailable 2. Masking strategy: - Rainfall data doesn't require cloud masking in the traditional sense - CHIRPS is a blended satellite+station product, so it's already processed - Just need to sum precipitation over the month and check if > 22 inches (558.8 mm) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - If no images exist for January 2020 → C1 - If pixel count is 0 after processing → C2 - If result is NaN or null → C3 - If result is valid number: check if > 22 inches → A (yes) or B (no) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Arrachart, Madagascar coordinates (approximately -19.43, 45.29) const arrachart = ee.Geometry.Point([45.29, -19.43]); const buffer = arrachart.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer for analysis // 2. Define January 2020 const startDate = '2020-01-01'; const endDate = '2020-01-31'; // 3. Load CHIRPS rainfall data let col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/PENTAD') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(buffer); const colSize = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS PENTAD images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try daily CHIRPS as fallback col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(buffer); const colSizeDaily = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS DAILY images found: ${colSizeDaily}`); if (colSizeDaily === 0) { console.log('No rainfall data available for January 2020 at Arrachart.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Sum all precipitation for January 2020 const totalPrecip = col.sum(); // 5. Calculate mean precipitation over the region const precipStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion( { reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 } ); const precipMM = precipStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Total precipitation (mm): ${precipMM}`); // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion( { reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 } ).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (precipMM === null || isNaN(precipMM)) { console.log('Calculation resulted in null or NaN.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) const precipInches = precipMM / 25.4; console.log(`Total precipitation (inches): ${precipInches.toFixed(2)}`); // 7. Compare to 22 inches threshold const threshold = 22; if (precipInches > threshold) { console.log(`${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches > ${threshold} inches`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`${precipInches.toFixed(2)} inches <= ${threshold} inches`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
